easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
If Xenograft requires you to choose a type, Saproling was chosen.
description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Xenograft and a Forest in addition to its other types due to Life and Limb, causing Titania to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Titania trigger, creating a 5/3 green Elemental creature token.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.
